feedback.answered: The non-monotonic installSnapshot reasoning is now cited exactly and its applicability is stated in terms of the default configuration. compactLogsWithTrailing returns without deleting anything when lastLogIdx <= trailingLogs, and otherwise deletes only [FirstIndex, min(snapIdx, lastLogIdx-trailing)] (snapshot.go 216-247), so the store's last index is never reduced below the watermark; installSnapshot reaches this through compactLogs(req.LastLogIndex) on the non-monotonic branch, while the monotonic branch calls removeOldLogs, which passes trailingLogs zero and clears the log. DefaultConfig sets TrailingLogs to 10240 (config.go 316-330), so with the default any node whose log holds at most 10240 entries performs no compaction at all during an install, and the watermark therefore keeps naming a retained entry - which is why the confirmed mismatch measured by check 58ebdb2f92184614b01ecfab56fe2bc9 belongs to the log-clearing branch rather than to compaction in general.
